review:
The Diamond Edition of 12 Coins pushes the Grand Jackpot up to 5,000x, one of the biggest prizes in the Coins series. It plays on 12 reels, and the Hold the Jackpot round is still the heart of it.

The other upgrade is Cash Out. Wazdan calls this the most rewarding version of the feature, built to give you more prizes during the base game, so you're not just waiting for the bonus. Cash Infinity and Chance Level are both here as usual. High volatility, 96.14% RTP. If you like the Coins idea but want a huge top prize on a smaller grid, this is the one.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
